description: Tracks the progress of the season arc — which storylines are active, which are resolved, and where each subplot stands. Updated after each episode is locked.

act_one.description: Setup — introduce world, characters, engine. Establish status quo, then disrupt it.

act_two.description: Complication — stakes escalate. Personal life collides with the case. Mid-season twist.

act_three.description: Crisis — everything the protagonist thought they knew is challenged. Cost becomes personal.

act_four.description: Resolution or refusal to resolve. Season question answered or refused.

character_arcs.description: Track where each character is in their arc at the end of each locked episode

mythology_progress.description: What the audience knows about the season's central mystery at each point
